# Sessions Checklist: Mods That Talk To and Start Other Sessions

**Purpose**: Check that the spec's requirements for started sessions, evidence and the verdict are complete and clear
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Session Lifecycle and Cleanup

- [ ] CHK001 Is "stopped" defined for each way a session can start (headless process, interactive session, worktree)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the process check specified well enough to tell a started process from the user's own sessions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the time limit for a started session given as a number, next to the turn limit? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are cleanup requirements defined for a test that is stopped partway (by the user or by a crash)? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK005 Is worktree removal stated as a requirement, not only as an edge case? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Test Outcomes and Evidence

- [ ] CHK006 Are the outcome labels the same in FR-003, the Key Entities and SC-001 (full pass, partial pass, pass, blocked)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "a different approach" defined, so that 3 tries of one approach do not count as 3 approaches? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the kinds of evidence that count for Q1 to Q5 listed, and is a reasoned guess excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it defined what "the result comes back" means for test 3 (exact text, a file, an exit status)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the case "the second session is not running" kept apart from a blocked API in test 1's outcome? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Verdict

- [ ] CHK011 Is the D12 rule written in the spec in a form a reader can check part by part? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it stated which test results count for each D12 part (test 2 or test 3 for "starts", which tests for "result back")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the Claude Code version a requirement of the report, not only an assumption? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Privacy and Cost

- [ ] CHK014 Is "lowest cost model" tied to one named model, so the requirement cannot drift? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, AS1]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it defined what counts as "test text" and what must be left out of the report and mods? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it stated that no network call leaves this machine except the normal model calls of the started sessions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]

## Notes

- Focus: session lifecycle and cleanup, and evidence and verdict quality. Depth: standard. Reader: the owner before the plan.
